Tại NatsMonitor.tsx:955-988, khi isWorkQueue va last > 0 thi hien thi Tag mau green Da xu ly: #last, luon hien thi Cuoi: lastTs khi lastTs khac '-', va voi CDC_EVENTS khi msgs === 0 thi hien thi Tag Direct Kafka->RAM (Bypass NATS).

Tại NatsMonitor.tsx:2148-2171, khi peekData.total_messages === 0, giao dien hien thi Alert type success cho stream co retention workqueue (khi peekData.last_seq > 0) va Alert type warning cho stream CDC_EVENTS giai thich co che In-Memory Bypass.
